concepts.label: Infra repo
concepts.definition: Terraform and Kubernetes configuration for the company.

memories.text: Use poetry for dependency management in pipeline-ml; do not use uv in this repository.
memories.note: twin of d-uv: the other project uses uv

memories.text: Set the python, numpy and torch random seeds at the start of every training script in pipeline-ml.
Train with bf16 mixed precision whenever an NVIDIA GPU is present.
On a machine without a GPU run only the smoke-test config and never launch a full training run.
Pipeline-ml checkpoints are written to /data/checkpoints and deleted after 14 days.
Batch size 512 ran out of memory on the 24 GB card; batch size 256 with gradient accumulation fit.

fields.situation: a training run crashes with CUDA out of memory
fields.insight: batch 512 does not fit in 24 GB

memories.text: Pipeline-ml runs on Python 3.10.
Pipeline-ml runs on Python 3.11 since the CUDA image upgrade.
Write docstrings in Google style in pipeline-ml.
Run terraform plan and read the whole diff before any terraform apply.
Terraform state for the infra repo lives in the S3 bucket northwind-tfstate with locking in DynamoDB.
Deploy to the staging namespace first; production deploys need an approved change ticket.
A rolling update stalled because the readiness probe path no longer matched the renamed health endpoint.

fields.situation: a deployment hangs during a rolling update
fields.insight: the readiness probe path changed with the health endpoint
fields.do_instead: check probes whenever an endpoint is renamed

memories.text: Never commit secrets or .env files; fetch credentials with the vault CLI.
After cloning any repository run pre-commit install.
Use function components and hooks in storefront; no class components.
Fix every ESLint warning in storefront before opening a pull request.
Every interactive element in storefront needs an accessible name: an aria-label or visible text.
Chose TypeScript strict mode for storefront because most production bugs were undefined access.

fields.rationale: most production bugs were undefined access

memories.text: On 2026-10-02 the storefront bundle grew to 4 MB after a whole icon library was imported; per-icon imports fixed it.
Handle a flaky test: quarantine it with the flaky marker, open a ticket, and fix it within a week.

steps: mark the test as flaky so it is quarantined
open a ticket with the failing log
fix or delete it within a week

memories.text: Review a pull request: read the description, run it locally, check tests and migrations, comment, then approve.

fields.trigger: asked to review a pull request
steps: read the description and linked ticket
check that tests and migrations are included
leave comments, then approve or request changes

memories.text: The on-call rotation hands over on Mondays at 10:00; the pager runbook is in the ops wiki.
During the August outage the rollback script was untested and failed; rehearse rollbacks every quarter.

fields.insight: the rollback script had never been tested

memories.text: Upgrade storefront CI to Node 22 before the LTS change.
